primary_claim: Independently trained sibling transformers compute the same function but their residual-stream activation bases differ by a rotation statistically indistinguishable from a uniform (Haar) draw on SO(d): applying one seed's SAE to another seed's activations catastrophically fails (negative explained variance) despite high (~0.9) decoder-column cosine similarity, while a single orthogonal Procrustes rotation restores reconstruction to 0.85-0.99 EV with no retraining.

effect.value: 0.976-0.990 on toy model (vs worst-case -6.56 pre-rotation); 0.85-0.99 on Pythia-70m (vs -2.11 to 0.75 pre-rotation)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Qualifies the SAE universality literature (Towards Monosemanticity, Scaling Monosemanticity, Gemma Scope, Cunningham et al., Lan et al.), which interprets high cross-model decoder-column cosine similarity as evidence that models learn 'the same features' -- shows this hides catastrophic cross-model encoder failure and that decoder cosine alone is insufficient evidence of feature transfer

Off-topic finding: attribution patching is anti-correlated or uncorrelated with true patch effects on converged models, contradicting its use as a reliable importance-estimation method there; recommends integrated gradients instead
stated_future_work: frontier-scale (10B+ parameter) replication on any open-weight model pair
systematic sweep of cross-checkpoint rotation across more layers, seeds, and checkpoints
test whether rotating steering vectors by the Procrustes rotation improves transfer in the inverted regime
test whether parameter-level joint alignment can reduce cross-seed MSE to threshold level
limitations_stated: the parametric acceptance bar (joint weight-level alignment) failed completely and the author showed it cannot be improved by more search
the cross-checkpoint drift rotation result (§7) is a single data point (one layer, one seed, one checkpoint pair) and should not be taken seriously without further study
the toy model uses a coordinated cohort sharing frozen input/output weights, which simplifies the parametric analysis relative to a fully independent cohort
quote: Reconstruction score drops to negative explained variance - worse than ignoring the input entirely and predicting the mean activation.
